spoilers.title: #ONEPIECE1190 BRUUUHH GABAN ROASTED LUFFY😭💀💀💀 The Will of Marco (マルコの意志) (@TheWillOfMarco) #ONEPIECE1190 GABAN GIVES LUFFY A HARSH AND BRUTAL SCOLDING 🗣️🔥🔥🔥 --------------------------- Before
spoilers.text: #ONEPIECE1190 BRUUUHH GABAN ROASTED LUFFY😭💀💀💀 The Will of Marco (マルコの意志) (@TheWillOfMarco) #ONEPIECE1190 GABAN GIVES LUFFY A HARSH AND BRUTAL SCOLDING 🗣️🔥🔥🔥 --------------------------- Before blocking Imu's attack on Luffy, it seems that Gaban slashed the tree where Luffy was pinned into several sections. As the tree sections falls, the two swords impaling Luffy came loose. Gaban sees Imu for the first time, and the two begin to converse. Gaban to Imu: What a dreadful appearance... It doesn't even look like something from this world...!! Imu: Who art thou? Gaban: A person who knows of the world... Luffy: AAAHHHHHH!!! Gaban: Hey... *Gaban picks Luffy up by the scruff and holds him up* Gaban: Get up, Straw Hat Luffy... Luffy: UWAAAHHHHH!!! OWWOWWOWWWWWWW!!! Gaban: I'm disappointed in you...!! Getting saved by an injured old geezer like me... Don't you feel ashamed...?! "White form" ?! "Yonko" ?! Luffy: Ow-ow-ow-ow-ow-ow-ow-ow!!! Gaban: Don't get full of yourself!!! Luffy: Owwww!!! Old mban!!! Ledd go ovv mbe!!! Gaban: Do you plan to die here!? Luffy: I... I'mb dot godda die!! Ow-ow-ow, led me go... Gaban: No, you were basically dead!! Pathetic!! If you die, what do you think will happen?! Luffy: I won't be able... to protect my friend's country...!!! Gaban: That's right!! What will happen to your crew that you brought all the way here?! Luffy: Their lives... would be at risk...!! Huff... Gaban: That's right... listen, in this sea... the higher you climb, the more enemies you gain! The "Pirate King" is a title given to someone whose death is rejoiced*!! Because everybody wants to sit in that throne!!! (This is the reference to the chapter title: "One Whose Death Is Rejoiced") Luffy: Agh... Ugh... Gaban: If you think you can become the "Pirate King" peacefully, cheerfully, and merrily, go back to your hometown!! Luffy: Damn it...!!! Gaban: You're not built for this!! *Gaban throws Luffy away* Luffy: Waahhh!!! Gaban: You'll just get in my way, you shitty brat!! Luffy: Owwwww!! Ugh...!! *Luffy fells face down on the ground* Luffy: Damn it!! That old geezer!! Saying just whatever he wants!! Just you wait...!! — https://nitter.net/TheWillOfMarco/status/2085236689560322410#m
